name: RA_CUST_PAY_METHOD_INT_ALL
description: RA_CUST_PAY_METHOD_INT_ALL contains the customer receipt methods while importing the customer information. It is part of the customer interface program.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system of customer data. Use the Manage Source Systems task to identify valid values. Examples: Siebel, Dun and Bradstreet.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Uniquely identifies customer in original source system. Must be unique if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is I. Must be an existing value if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is U.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Receipt method name. Use the Manage Receipt Classes and Methods task to identify valid values.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Primary receipt method indicator. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system of customer site data. Use the Manage Source Systems task to identify valid values. Examples: Siebel, Dun and Bradstreet.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Uniquely identifies customer site in original source system. Must be unique if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is I. Must be an existing value if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is U.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Payment method start date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Payment method deactivation date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier. Must be unique. Free text field.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Receipt method set identifier. Use the Manage Business Units task to identify valid values.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the Customer Import load job that created the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
